examples.en: The Statue of Liberty is a noble gift.
examples.zh: 自由女神像是一份崇高的礼物。

examples.en: It is one of the most famous monuments in the world.
examples.zh: 它是世界上最著名的纪念碑之一。

examples.en: The monument is a symbol of liberty.
examples.zh: 这座纪念碑是自由的象征。

examples.en: The great statue took ten years to complete.
examples.zh: 这座巨大的雕像花了十年时间才完成。

examples.en: The Statue of Liberty stands in New York Harbour.
examples.zh: 自由女神像矗立在纽约港。

examples.en: The statue was designed by a famous sculptor.
examples.zh: 这座雕像由一位著名雕刻家设计。

examples.en: The actual figure was made of copper.
examples.zh: 雕像本身是用铜制成的。

examples.en: The figure was made of copper.
It was supported by a metal framework.
The framework was constructed by Eiffel.

examples.zh: 埃菲尔建造了这个金属框架。

examples.en: The statue was transported to the United States.
The site chosen was an island.
examples.zh: 选定的地点是一个小岛。

examples.en: A pedestal had to be built first.
The island is at the entrance of New York Harbour.
examples.zh: 这座小岛位于纽约港入口处。

examples.en: A statue was erected in Paris in 1884.
The statue was officially presented to the American people.
examples.zh: 雕像被正式赠送给了美国人民。

examples.en: The dove is a symbol of peace.

sentences.en: The great statue, which was designed by the sculptor Auguste Bartholdi, took ten years to complete.
sentences.zh: 这座巨大的雕像由雕刻家奥古斯特·巴托尔迪设计，花了十年时间才完成。

sentences.en: The actual figure was made of copper supported by a metal framework.
sentences.zh: 雕像本身由铜制成，由金属框架支撑。

sentences.en: Before it could be transported to the United States, a site had to be found for it.
sentences.zh: 在把它运往美国之前，必须先为它选好场地。

sentences.en: The site chosen was an island at the entrance of New York Harbour.
sentences.zh: 选定的地点是纽约港入口处的一座小岛。

sentences.en: The following year, it was taken to pieces and sent to America.
sentences.zh: 第二年，它被拆散运往美国。

article.en: One of the most famous monuments in the world, the Statue of Liberty, was presented to the United States of America in the nineteenth century by the people of France.
article.zh: 世界上最著名的纪念碑之一——自由女神像，是法国人民在十九世纪赠送给美利坚合众国的。

article.en: The great statue, which was designed by the sculptor Auguste Bartholdi, took ten years to complete.
article.zh: 这座巨大的雕像由雕刻家奥古斯特·巴托尔迪设计，花了十年时间才完成。

article.en: The actual figure was made of copper supported by a metal framework.
article.zh: 雕像本身由铜制成，由金属框架支撑。

article.en: The framework had been especially constructed by Eiffel.
article.zh: 框架是埃菲尔特别建造的。

article.en: Before it could be transported to the United States, a site had to be found for it.
article.zh: 在把它运往美国之前，必须先为它选好场地。

article.en: A pedestal had to be built.
The site chosen was an island at the entrance of New York Harbour.
article.zh: 选定的地点是纽约港入口处的一座小岛。

article.en: By 1884, a statue which was 151 feet tall had been erected in Paris.
article.zh: 到1884年，一座151英尺高的雕像已在巴黎竖立起来。

article.en: The following year, it was taken to pieces and sent to America.
article.zh: 第二年，它被拆散运往美国。

article.en: By the end of October 1886, the statue had been put together again and it was officially presented to the American people.
article.zh: 到1886年10月底，雕像重新组装起来，由巴托尔迪正式赠送给了美国人民。
